_comment: Ratcheting allowlists for scripts/check_dependency_layers.py.  `generic_imports_sources` reached EMPTY on 2026-07-28: BlockSum.lean needed one relation from the source layer, now staged as ContinuousLinearMap.HasSameApproximationNumbers, and OperatorModulus.lean's two paper-facing theorems moved into the source module whose vocabulary they used.  The list is kept rather than deleted so a regression is still reported against a named rule. These capture the pre-migration state as of Davis-Kahan fc38eb4 so the checker is green today and flags only NEW regressions. Entries are transitional backwards-dependencies that later extraction PRs remove; do not add to these lists to work around the architecture.  `production_imports_spectra` (added 2026-07-28) is the burn-down list for rule 7: production modules that reach Spectra directly rather than through DavisKahan.Interop.Spectra. AGENTS.md states the final migration target removes Spectra from the normal build, and three extraction clusters are blocked-on-spectra-removal; this list makes the coupling visible and, being ratcheting, keeps new coupling out. It may only shrink.  It went 12 -> 10 when the polar geometry came off Spectra and 10 -> 8 when the Hilbert-Schmidt basis theory did.  The eight that remain fall into four kinds, and none is removable by relocating code: (1) Audits.SylvesterHilbertSchmidt is a `#check`/`#print axioms` audit surface whose whole purpose is to name Spectra declarations, and it is excluded from the ordinary aggregates; (2) Sylvester.{HilbertSchmidtDefectFirst,HilbertSchmidtPairwise} need Spectra's one-parameter-group generator and spectral-gap machinery (`OneParameterUnitaryGroup.generator`, `HilbertSchmidtTensor.sylvesterGroup`, `SpectralTheory.spectralGapSolution`), which has no Mathlib counterpart; (3) SpectralTheory.{CayleySelectorBridge,ClosedOperator.Complexification,SelfAdjointBorelCalculus} need the Cayley transform, resolvent and Borel functional calculus for unbounded self-adjoint operators -- Complexification is the thinnest of these, using only `Spectra.Resolvent.spectrum`, so it is the next candidate; (4) Sylvester.{PairwiseHomogeneousUniqueness,PairwiseSpectrumGap} are inside the U1 LinearPMap lane and must move with it.
